ops.name: add
ops.notice: a + b, rounded once (half up on the magnitude). The result is exact whenever it is representable; a - a is +0.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the sum does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: sub
ops.notice: a - b, rounded once. Exact whenever representable (Sterbenz: always for b/2 <= a <= 2b).
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the difference does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: mul
ops.notice: a * b: the 474-bit product of the significands, rounded once.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the product does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: div
ops.notice: a / b: floor(ma 2^255 / mb) by two exact 2^128 stages, rounded once.
ops.reverts: DivisionByZero() for b == 0; Overflow() when the quotient does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: sqrt
ops.notice: sqrt(x): the significand shifted to an even exponent, its integer square root at 2^136 (Newton: a 256-bit seed, one 2^128 stage, one 2^256 stage, corrected by squaring), rounded once. Never overflows or underflows.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x < 0 or a word that is not a number

ops.name: exp
ops.notice: e^x = 2^(x log2 e): the 512-bit product of the significand and log2 e in two words (2^-508), split into the integer part and a fraction at 2^-254, then the 2^f kernel (within 6 units of 2^-254) and one rounding when that bound clears the rounding boundary, else e^r - 1 in two words for r = x - k ln 2: correctly rounded. Below 2^-118, 1 + x + x^2/2 floored exactly on the 2^-254 grid (the cubic only breaks ties) and rounded once; a positive x whose lowest bit is 2^-118, below 2^-84, makes that sum an exact tie the kernel cannot see past, so it takes the same path. Exactly one below 2^-238; zero below about -181,700.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when e^x does not fit (x above about 181,705); OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: ln
ops.notice: ln(x) = (E - bias + log2(M / 2^236)) ln 2: the exponent exactly, the mantissa through the log2 kernel at 2^-254, the sum scaled to fill a word, one product with ln 2 and one rounding when its 40 units clear the rounding boundary, else u ln 2 + ln(mantissa) in two words (one Newton step on the kernel's value): correctly rounded. Within 2^-8 of one, d = x - 1 is exact and ln(1 + d) = d * series(d) at 2^-254 (in two words when needed), so the relative precision holds all the way down.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x <= 0 or a word that is not a number

ops.name: pow
ops.notice: x^y = 2^(y log2 x): log2 x as a scaled word from the kernel (or the near-one series), its exact 512-bit product with y's significand split into the integer part and a fraction at 2^-254, then the 2^f kernel; one rounding when the error bound (which grows with |y| or |t|) clears the rounding boundary, else an exact tie when x^y has at most 238 bits, else log2 x in two words (wln) times y and 2^f by wexpm1: correctly rounded. 0^0 = 1. Shortcuts for y in {1, 2, 1/2, -1}.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x < 0; DivisionByZero() for 0^y with y < 0; Overflow() when the result does not fit

ops.name: log1p
ops.notice: ln(1 + x) without forming a rounded 1 + x. Below 2^-4, x times the ln series at 2^-254 (32 terms below 2^-8, 64 above), so the relative precision holds all the way down; above, 1 + x exactly on a 2^-254 grid under its leading bit, the log2 kernel and one product with ln 2. Each fast value carries its error bound; when it reaches the rounding boundary the series or ln(1 + x) is recomputed in two words. Correctly rounded.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x <= -1 or a word that is not a number

ops.name: expm1
ops.notice: e^x - 1 without cancellation. Below 2^-8, x times the series sum x^k / (k + 1)! at 2^-254; above, exp's split of x log2 e and its unrounded 2^f, with the one subtracted on the same 2^-254 grid; each within its bound, recomputed in two words when that reaches the rounding boundary. Correctly rounded; -1 below about -176.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when e^x - 1 does not fit (x above about 181,705); OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: erf
ops.notice: The error function. Below 1/2, x (2/sqrt pi) e^(-x^2) times the all-positive series sum (2x^2)^k / (2k+1)!!; above, 1 - erfc with erfc = e^(-x^2) g(x) from the anchors or the continued fraction (see erfc). e^(-x^2) comes from the exact square. One rounding when the fast value's error bound clears the rounding boundary, else the series in two words below 7 and 1 - erfc by the continued fraction in two words above: correctly rounded. +-1 from |x| >= 13.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: erfc
ops.notice: The complementary error function as a product, never a difference, for x >= 1/2: erfc(x) = e^(-x^2) g(x), g = e^(x^2) erfc from a Taylor series around 45 anchors on [1/2, 6] and the continued fraction above, e^(-x^2) from the exact 474-bit square, so the tail keeps 71 digits until it underflows 2^-262142 near x = 427. 1 - erf below 1/2, 2 - erfc(-x) below zero. One rounding, or the wide second stage (the series and 1 - erf below 7, the continued fraction above, in two words) when the fast value's error bound reaches the rounding boundary: correctly rounded.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: normCdf
ops.notice: The standard normal distribution function Phi(x) = erfc(-x / sqrt 2) / 2, with e^(-x^2/2) from the exact square, so the left tail keeps 71 digits until it underflows near x = -603 (the 18-decimal grid is empty from about -8.3); one rounding, or erf's wide second stage at y = |x| / sqrt 2: correctly rounded; exactly one from x >= 13 sqrt 2.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: lambertW0
ops.notice: The principal branch of Lambert W, W(x) e^W(x) = x, W >= -1. Seeds as FP127's: the branch-point series in p = sqrt(2(1 + e x)) with 1 + e x exact, x - x^2 + 3/2 x^3 on (-1/4, 0), Winitzki's L (1 - ln(1 + L)/(2 + L)), L = ln(1 + x), above. Six Newton steps on the float ops: w e^w = x up to 3, the log form w + ln w = ln x above (no e^w, so the whole range up to W = 181,700 works); near -1/e, below p = 2^-21, the ten-term series. Then one Newton step at 2^-510 on w + ln|w| = ln|x| (the residual in three words) and one rounding: correctly rounded.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() below -1/e or for a word that is not a number

ops.name: lambertWm1
ops.notice: The secondary real branch of Lambert W, W(x) <= -1. Seeds as FP127's: the branch-point series in -p for x < -1/4, the asymptotic L - ln(-L) + ln(-L)/L, L = ln(-x), above; seven log-form Newton steps (w + ln(-w) = ln(-x), no e^w: W reaches about -181,700 at the bottom of the format), then one log-form Newton step at 2^-510 and one rounding: correctly rounded.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() outside that or for a word that is not a number

ops.name: powu
ops.notice: x^n for |n| below 2^16 by binary exponentiation on a 256-bit significand with its own exponent, each product keeping its top 256 bits, rounded once at the end: exact whenever x^n fits 256 bits (so every exactly representable power and every exact tie), else within (2n + 8) units, and through pow when that reaches the rounding boundary. n < 0 inverts the final significand once. From 2^16 on, pow(|x|, n) with the sign restored. Correctly rounded for |n| < 2^237 (n is a number from there). 0^0 = 1.
ops.domain: any number x, any plain integer n (not a number); the result must fit
ops.reverts: Overflow() when x^n does not fit; DivisionByZero() for 0^n with n < 0; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: compound
ops.notice: (1 + rate)^n without forming a rounded 1 + rate (a per-second rate needs 266 bits for it): log2(1 + rate) unrounded, as log1p takes it (the series below 2^-4, 1 + rate exact under its leading bit above), its exact product with n, then pow's 2^t; one rounding when its error bound clears the rounding boundary, else an exact tie when the power has at most 238 bits, else log2(1 + rate) in two words times n exactly: correctly rounded.
ops.domain: rate >= -1, any plain integer n (not a number); the result must fit
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for rate < -1; DivisionByZero() for rate = -1 with n < 0; Overflow() when the result does not fit

ops.name: neg
ops.notice: -x: the sign bit flipped; -0 is 0.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: abs
ops.notice: |x|: the sign bit cleared.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: sign
ops.notice: -1, 0 or 1 as numbers.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: cmp
ops.notice: -1, 0 or 1 as plain integers: the order of a and b.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: lt
ops.notice: 1 if a < b, else 0, as a plain integer.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: eq
ops.notice: 1 if a == b, else 0. Representations are unique, so this is bit equality.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: fromUint
ops.notice: The number x, exact below 2^237, rounded once above.
ops.reverts: never

ops.name: fromFP127
ops.notice: The number x / 2^128: exact whenever |x| has at most 237 significant bits (every |x| below 2^237, and larger ones with trailing zeros), rounded once otherwise.
ops.reverts: never

ops.name: toFP127
ops.notice: The 127.128 word nearest to x, half up on the magnitude: zero below 2^-129, one raw unit from there to 2^-128.
ops.reverts: Overflow() at or above 2^127 (-2^127 is allowed); OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: fromFixed18
ops.notice: The number x / 10^18: the integer as a number (exact below 2^237), divided by 10^18 with one rounding.
ops.reverts: never

ops.name: toFixed18
ops.notice: The 18-decimal word nearest to x, half up on the magnitude, from the exact 512-bit product M 10^18.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when x 10^18 does not fit int256; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: mulDown
ops.notice: a * b rounded toward minus infinity: the largest number at or below the exact product (the 474-bit product of the significands and a sticky bit). A product below the smallest number is zero when positive and minus the smallest number when negative.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the product does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: mulUp
ops.notice: a * b rounded toward plus infinity: the smallest number at or above the exact product. A positive product below the smallest number is the smallest number, never zero.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the product does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: divDown
ops.notice: a / b rounded toward minus infinity: div's exact floor quotient and a sticky bit from the remainder, mulmod(ma, 2^255, mb).
ops.reverts: DivisionByZero() for b == 0; Overflow() when the quotient does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: divUp
ops.notice: a / b rounded toward plus infinity: the smallest number at or above the exact quotient.
ops.reverts: DivisionByZero() for b == 0; Overflow() when the quotient does not fit; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: toUintDown
ops.notice: floor(x) as a plain uint256, exact for every number in range: what a protocol pays out.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x < 0 or a word that is not a number; Overflow() at or above 2^256

ops.name: toUintUp
ops.notice: ceil(x) as a plain uint256, exact: what a protocol charges.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for x < 0 or a word that is not a number; Overflow() at or above 2^256

ops.name: toIntDown
ops.notice: floor(x) as a plain int256 (toward minus infinity), exact.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when floor(x) does not fit int256; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: toIntUp
ops.notice: ceil(x) as a plain int256 (toward plus infinity), exact.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when ceil(x) does not fit int256; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: floor
ops.notice: The largest integral number at or below x, exact (x itself from 2^236 on, where every number is an integer).
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: ceil
ops.notice: The smallest integral number at or above x, exact.
ops.reverts: OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: toFixed18Down
ops.notice: The 18-decimal word at or below x (toward minus infinity), from the exact 512-bit product M 10^18: what a protocol pays out in 18-decimal units.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the result does not fit int256; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: toFixed18Up
ops.notice: The 18-decimal word at or above x (toward plus infinity): what a protocol charges; a positive x below 10^-18 is one unit, never zero.
ops.reverts: Overflow() when the result does not fit int256; OutOfRange() for a word that is not a number

ops.name: fromUintDown
ops.notice: The largest number at or below x: x itself below 2^237, x truncated to 237 significant bits above.
ops.reverts: never

ops.name: fromUintUp
ops.notice: The smallest number at or above x: x itself below 2^237, x rounded up to 237 significant bits above (2^256 for the largest).
ops.reverts: never
